meta.title: Functions currently addressed by mrhunsaker/3dmakeGUI
meta.evidence: The repo tree could not be fetched (GitHub blocks automated access). This inventory is taken from the published README of the repo's vscode-extension (VS Code Marketplace TVIResources.vscode-3dmake-gui, version listing 2026.5.2 / VSIX 2026.4.29), which states it is built from 3dmakeGUI/vscode-extension and 'wraps every 3dm subcommand'.
limitations: If 3dmakeGUI contains other front-ends (e.g. a desktop or web GUI) beside vscode-extension/, they are NOT covered here. Step 0 of the remediation plan scans the whole repo and appends them.

'cli_executed' is what the extension README says it runs. The 'cli_correct' verdicts are derived by checking each string against the argparse and verb-resolution logic in tdeck/3dmake 3dm.py, not by running it.

implementation_facts.process_model: Node child_process spawn; stdout/stderr streamed to an Output Channel (README)
implementation_facts.binary_resolution: setting 3dmake.binaryPath, else PATH, else env THREE_DM_PATH / THREEDM_PATH

gui_commands.label: Slice
gui_commands.real_cli: 3dm slice (project-mode STL must exist or 3dm must imply build: verify)

gui_commands.label: Build + Slice
gui_commands.why: '--slice' is a dashed token not defined in argparse -> 'Unknown option(s): --slice'. Actions are positional verbs.

gui_commands.label: Open/Edit Source
gui_commands.why: Opens src/*.scad in VS Code instead of running edit-model; acceptable inside an IDE but violates 'direct execution' requirement; also ignores -m and the default-template creation.

gui_commands.label: New Project
gui_commands.why: '<name>' without a '.' is parsed as an action verb -> "Unknown action '<name>'"; 'new' takes no name.

gui_commands.label: Run Setup
gui_commands.why: Setup is interactive (stdin prompts). The extension spawns with piped output and no stdin passthrough, so prompts cannot be answered unless a terminal is used (verify).

gui_commands.label: Self-Update
gui_commands.why: May prompt for confirmation on stdin (verify); no stdin passthrough.

gui_commands.label: Run Custom Command
gui_commands.note: Escape hatch; keep it but it must not be the only route to missing features

gui_options_exposed.label: View (-v)
gui_options_exposed.note: setting enumerates 6 silhouette values only; plane views not offered

coverage_summary.chaining_supported: only two hardcoded chains, both with invalid syntax

defects_found.text: 7 commands emit syntax that 3dm rejects (build --slice, build --orient --slice, images, new <name>, libraries --list, libraries --install, profiles, overlays). These cannot have worked against current 3dm.
Actions are modeled as ad-hoc subcommand strings, not derived from 3dm's verb/flag model, so drift is guaranteed.
No stdin passthrough: setup, edit-overlay prompts, info -i, self-update confirmations cannot work.
edit-* actions bypassed with direct file opens, so edit_in_background/editor config and template/creation logic of 3dm are skipped.
Output parsing for post-run behaviour (open STL/SVG/images) is heuristic ('detected from output'); should use deterministic build/ paths.
